about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-17 from commit ad6b13a), since its mage sim ships no weights. Its Arcane preset (talents, rotation, buffs) on its own Preraid gear set (ui/specs/mage/dps/gear_sets/preraid.gear.json, which every mage build uses), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. The tool's new per-school spell hit rows were left out. Run in the app's browser on 17 Nov 2026 (US Central). Before it (15 Nov, from e4ef929): Intellect 0.91, Spell Damage 1.0, Arcane Spell Damage 0.89, Fire Spell Damage 0.11, Frost Spell Damage 0.0, Spell Piercing 2.41, Spirit 0.15, 1% Hit 15.1, 1% Crit 10.04, 1% Haste 19.23, Mana 0.02, MP5 0.18.
